PRIVACY

A straightforward approach.

How this chapter website handles information.

Chapter website

This website provides chapter information and a browser-based banner generator. It does not include a membership application form, account system, contact submission form or member database.

Banner generator

Your banner name, selected LGA and photo are processed locally in your browser. The generator does not upload them to a server, save them to a database or retain them after you leave or reset the page. The downloaded PNG contains the name, photo and optional LGA you choose, so only share details you want to make public.

Support group registration

The support group registration form is hosted by Google Forms and loads when you open it. Details you submit are sent to the form owner through Google Forms and are subject to Google’s privacy policy and the form owner’s data practices.

Membership and external websites

Registration links open the national City Boy Movement platform. Information you submit there is governed by that platform’s privacy policy and terms.

External services

Fonts are requested from Google Fonts. Hosting and font providers may process technical connection information, such as IP addresses, under their own policies. This website has no added analytics or marketing trackers.

Cookies and access

This site does not add its own tracking cookies. The hosting platform may use cookies or session information required to control access to the site.

Questions

See the Contact page for current enquiry routes.
